Title: Set Fabric Textures
Content: Objective Express texture or pattern of the fabric. Location Object Browser Fabric Operation Select the menu indicated in Location. Select a fabric. Fabric Property appears in Property Editor. Refer to the below table to set the base texture. PBR (Default) Option Description Type Set the appropriate Material Type. Texture Click the explore button and apply a texture image from Library/Folder Note: Click both back and side tabs and deactivate 'Use Same Materials as Front' to apply different materials to other faces of the pattern. Remove Texture Color Remove the default color to apply other colors while retaining the pattern or texture. Normal Map Apply Normal Map image to express uneven texture more realistically. Automatic When a texture is applied, Normal Map is generated by adjusting the Intensity. Higher intensity makes the embossed detail raised off the surface, the lower intensity makes the details lower than the surface. Manual Click the explore or apply the Normal Map image from the Library/Folder Note: Use the normal map image made with the exclusive tool to achieve an accurate normal effect. Also, add a normal map that is different with texture in order to create an extra pattern of surface. Color Express each of the fabrics in various colorways Opacity Adjust Opacity to create sheer fabric. Note: When you apply opacity to texture, change Garment Rendering Style as Thick Textured Surface. Roughness Intensity Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness Map Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying Roughness Map. Map Select the Browse button next to the Map option to add a Roughness Map to the selected Fabric style. Map Intensity Adjust the Map's Intensity. Invert Select to invert the gloss of the fabric. When this option is selected, the shinny part becomes dull and vice-versa. To use Specular Maps provided in below ver4.0.0, check this option. Reflection Intensity Greater the Reflection Intensity value is, more reflective than the material or fabric is and vice-versa. Note: Clicking on a Fabric from the Fabric List is going to highlight the Patterns where the Fabric is being applied to, in the 3D/2D window. Clicking on a Pattern in the 3D or 2D window is going to highlight the Fabric where it is being applied to, in the Object Browser Fabric Tab.

Title: Move Button
Content: Objective Move buttons as desired. Location Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Operation Move Buttons with Click-and-Drag Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Click and drag the buttons to the desired location on either of 2D or 3D Pattern. The selected buttons are now being moved accordingly. Move Buttons with Distance Input (ver2.5.0) Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button While click and dragging the buttons with left-click mouse button, click right-click mouse button in either of 2D or 3D window. The Moving Distance window appears. Enter desired value in the menu. Distance Moved Sets the moved distance of the buttonhole from its original location. Position Sets the position of the center of the buttonhole from the left/right/top/bottom of the Pattern outline. Click OK. The buttonholes are now being moved according to the input value. Note : It is able to select and move multiple buttons at once in the 2D window (ver2.4.0). The Gizmo for Select/Move Button tool has been changed from 2D rotation Gizmo to 3D translocation Gizmo (ver3.1.0).

Title: GoZ for Windows
Content: GoZ allows direct import/ export of Object between ZBrush and Marvelous Designer. Need to install GoZ installer for GoZ Marvelous Designer Plug-in in ZBrush. GoZ Install Download GoZ installer and Unzip to GoZApps folder To Activate GoZ function, need to installer GoZ Marvelous Designer Plug-in installer from ZBrush Download installer Download installer above, move the installer to GoZApps and unzip. Default Path: C:UsersPublicPixologicGoZApps Folder Named MarvelousDesigner will be unzipped. - To install GoZ Marvelous Designer, ZBrush need to be installed first. Install GoZ Marvelous Designer from ZBrush After unzip Marvelous Designer folder to GoZApps folder, run ZBrush. ZBrush Main menu &gt Preferences &gt GoZ &gt click Force reinstall. List will be displayed, Click Marvelous Designer from the list. Click 'Install' Button to start install. Once installation is completed, Marvelous Designer will be launched, can find GoZ menu on the Marvelous Designer main menu. Setting Marvelous Designer Path in ZBrush ZBrush Main menu &gt Preferences &gt GoZ &gt Click Update all paths Browse for desired path of Marvelous Designer and select. Also can install GoZ Marvelous Designer installer from Menu 'R' button on the right of GoZ button from ZBrush. Run GoZ from Marvelous Designer After installing GoZ Marvelous Designer, can directly export Garment, Avatar and Trims from Marvelous Designer by Run GoZ menu. Location Marvelous Designer Main Menu GoZ Run GoZ Operation Create or load Garment either Avatar to export by GoZ Select the tool according to the Location above. Garment/ Avatar will be added to ZBrush's Subtool according to GoZ export setting. Once the object is exported by GoZ, can edit and update by Run GoZ button. Run GoZ from ZBrush After installing GoZ, can directly export object to Marvelous Designer from ZBrush. Location ZBrush GoZ Operation Create an Object from ZBrush. Select the tool according to the Location above. Garment/ Avatar will be exported to Marvelous Designer according to Marvelous Designer's GoZ import setting. Once the object is exported by GoZ, can edit and update by GoZ button. GoZ Export Settings GoZ Export setting from Marvelous Designer to ZBrush. Location Marvelous Designer Main Menu GoZ Export Settings Operation Object Single Object Exports the selected object as a single object. Multiple Objects Exports the selected object as multiple objects. UnWeld Exports the Vertex (points of the mesh) of the parts of the pattern that are sewn together into one line into multiple objects. Weld Combines the Vertex (points of the mesh) of the parts of the pattern that are sewn together into one line into one point. Weld Selected Pattern: Weld based on the sewing line that connects the selected patterns. Thin Ensures that the thickness will not be exported even if the rendering thickness value is increased beforehand. Thick Exports a pattern with its rendering thickness values in its increased state. Include Avatar Shape: Save the Avatar as part of the file. Scale Adjusts the scale of the file being exported when a value is entered. * Reset: Reset all GoZ settings to Default. GoZ Import Settings GoZ Import setting from ZBrush to Marvelous Designer. Location Marvelous Designer Main Menu GoZ Import Settings Operation Object Type Load as Avatar Imports the object as an avatar and replaces the original avatar with the imported one. Load as Trim OBJs that are loaded as Trim do not have collision detection with the 3D Garment and will pass through the 3D Garment when simulated. Load as Garment Import an Object as Simulation ready Garment, can adjust Physical property from property editor Scale Manually enter the value. * Reset: Reset all GoZ settings to Default.

Title: UV EDITOR MODE: Change Normal Map Blending Method
Content: Objective This feature allows users to select the Normal Map Blending Method that provides the best results for their intended use. Location Settings/Preferences Preferences Graphic Options Normal Map Blending Operation Load garment with a blended normal map component, Example: Topstitching with the Type changed to "Texture" and the check box next to "3D" activated in the Property Editor. Change a window view mode to UV Editor, and change the display channel to Normal Map. Open Settings/Preferences in the Main Menu at the top of the interface, then select 'Preferences'. Move the Preferences window so that it does not cover the UV Editor. In the Preferences window, under Graphics Options, change the 'Normal Blending Method'. Observe the normal map for blended Normal Map components is changed. Bake out the normal map using the 'Bake Textures' option at the top of the UV Editor for application to the garment in an external 3D environment.

Title: OBJ TRIM: Transform OBJ Trims
Content: Objective Transform OBJ files loaded as trim as needed. Location Via the Scale Gizmo Load OBJ as Trim Scale Via the Property Editor Main Menu 3D Garment Select/Move 3D Toolbar Select/Move Operation Via the Scale Gizmo Load an OBJ. Follow the indicated guideline below: Load OBJ as Trim Scale Click and drag on the x,y, or z-axis to transform the OBJ. Axis Description X-Axis The red axis of the Gizmo. Click and drag the x-axis to transform the OBJ trim along its x-axis. Y-Axis The yellow-green axis of the Gizmo. Click and drag the y-axis to transform the OBJ trim along its y-axis. Z-Axis The blue axis of the Gizmo. Click and drag the z-axis to transform the OBJ along its z-axis. Square The yellow square located in the center of the Scale Gizmo. Click and drag the square to transform the OBJ trim, while maintaining its x, y, and z ratio. The OBJ is transformed. When the OBJ transformation is complete, click the Scale button again. The Gizmo used for moving and rotating OBJs appears. Via the Property Editor Load an OBJ. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 3D Garment Select/Move 3D Toolbar Select/Move Select the OBJ to be transformed. The properties of the OBJ appear in the Property Editor. Find the Scale option. Enter the desired value for the below options. Option Description X-Axis Enter the desired x-axis value. Y-Axis Enter the desired y-axis value. Z-Axis Enter the desired z-axis value. Maintain Ratio Toggle this option on to adjust an OBJ while maintaining its x, y, and z ratio.

Title: Shrink Pattern
Content: Objective Shrink or stretch 3D Garment Pattern horizontally and vertically without changing it in the 2D Pattern window. The default value is 100 percent (%) which indicates the natural state of the Garment material, in other words there is no artificial shrinkage or stretchiness. Use the function to express shrinkage after textile treatments such as garment washing, or use it temporarily to draw the inner layer against the avatar when dressing multiple layers of Garments for easier Simulation. Location Click Pattern Property Editor Simulation Properties Shrinkage Weft/Warp Operation Select a Pattern to shrink with 2D toolbar's Edit Pattern or Transform Pattern. Follow the indicated guideline below: Click Pattern Property Editor Simulation Properties Shrinkage Weft/Warp Enter desired shrink values. The Pattern in the 3D window is now being shrunk accordingly.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Default Color Setting
Content: Objective Set Topstitch default color in order to change the color. Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Topstitch Item Property Editor Material Color Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Topstitch Item Property Editor Material Color The Color palette window appears. Select color as desired. Note: The Eyedropper allows to extract color not only from Marvelous Designer but any other websites or images by simply clicking on the desired color. The extracted colors can also be added and saved in the color palette.

Title: Apply Fabric
Content: Objective Apply Fabrics (.zfab) to Patterns. Operation Apply from Property Editor Click on a Pattern, and choose a Fabric to apply from the Fabric menu in the Property Editor. The selected Fabric is now being applied to the selected Pattern accordingly. Note: Only Fabrics in the Fabric tab are being displayed in the corresponding Fabric menu. Assign to Selected Pattern Select a Pattern. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Fabric Assign to Selected Patterns The selected Fabric is now being applied to the selected Pattern accordingly. Assign to New Fabric Select a Pattern. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Fabric Assign to New Fabric Right-click Pattern Pop-up Menu Assign to New Fabric The new Fabric is now being applied to the selected Pattern and simultaneously added on the Fabric tab. Apply from Folder With Window File Search, open a folder where the Fabric files are being stored. Drag and drop a desired Fabric onto a pattern in 2D or 3D window. The selected Pattern is now being applied to the selected Pattern and simultaneously added on the Fabric tab. Or, drag and drop Fabric files onto Fabric tab of the Object Browser. In case of drag-and-dropping onto Fabric item, the previous Fabric style gets replaced. In case of drag-and-dropping onto the empty space, the Fabric gets added in the list. Apply from Library Window Open a folder where the Fabric files are being stored from the Library window. Drag and drop a desired Fabric onto a Pattern in 2D or 3D window. The selected Pattern is now being applied to the selected Pattern and simultaneously added on the Fabric List window. Drag and drop fabric files onto Fabric tab of the Object Browser: In case of drag-and-dropping onto Fabric item, the previous item gets replaced. In case of drag-and-dropping onto the empty space, the Fabric gets added in the list. Apply from Fabric Tab Drag and drop a desired Fabric onto a Pattern in 2D or 3D window. The selected Pattern is now being applied to the selected Pattern.

Title: Show Statistics (ver. 12.1)
Content: Feature Overview You can check various information related to the garment through the 'Show Statistics' Steps Follow the indicated guideline below to open 'Show Statistics'. Location Main Menu Display Environment Show Statistics View Options icon (3D Window) Environment Display Show Statistics End Result Information related to the garment will be displayed at the left bottom corner of the 3D Window. Please refer to the table below for the information items. Vertices The number of the vertices Edges The number of the edges Triangles The number of the triangular meshes Faces The number of the entire faces Patterns The number of the pattern pieces Trims The number of the trims Sewings The number of the Seam Line Pair Group CPUs The number of the activated CPU Fps Frames per Second, Simulation speed. F Garment, gravity time I Linear system time P Garment-garment proximity time S Garment-garment collision time O Avatar skinning time SK Avatar skinning + Joint animation time E Time excluding clothing simulation and avatar skinning in the overall simulation. R Rendering time. UI UI update time. T Simulation + Rendering + UI update time.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Length
Content: Objective Adjust the stitch length shown on the 3D Pattern. Location Topstitch Item Property Editor Length Operation Find and click the menu indicated in Location The length of the Topstitch will be adjusted according to the set values

Title: Garment Fit Maps
Content: Objective Utilize four Garment Fit Maps in the 3D window to check 3D Gament's fit. Location 3D Window Hover the Mouse Over the 5th Icon Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Window Hover the Mouse Over the 5th Icon Four Garment Fit Maps appear. Refer to the table below and select the desired view icon. Icon Description Stress Map (Below ver. 12) External stress causing garment distortion per area of the fabric appears in the range of color and numbers. Stress Map appears in a total of eight colors: Red indicates the strongest stress (100kPa) while blue indicates zero distortion (0.00kPa). Other numbers in between are expressed as gradation of two colors. Strain Map Garment's distortion rate due to external stress appears in percentage. Stain Map appears in a total of eight colors: Red indicates a 120% of distortion rate while blue indicates 100% (no distortion). Numbers in between are expressed as gradation of two colors. Fit Map (Below ver. 12) Fip Map shows the tightness of the 3D Garment. Can't Wear appears in red indicating not wearable area. Very Tight appears in orange indicating a very tight area. Tight appears in yellow indicating a slightly tight area. Show Pressure Points Show or hide contact points between 3D Garment and Avatar. Based on the selected icon, Stress Map, Strain Map, Fit Map, or Pressure Points appear on the 3D Garment.

Title: How to uninstall Marvelous Designer completely
Content: In the process of Live Update or alternately using multiple Marvelous Designer versions, various files, and settings that make up the Marvelous Designer software may be damaged, causing the Marvelous Designer software to not operate normally. You can solve this problem by completely uninstalling the Marvelous Designer software and configuration files and then reinstalling it with the latest Marvelous Designer installer. Note Only the files and settings that make up the Marvelous Designer software are deleted, and user-created files remain. Before uninstalling the Marvelous Designer software, please back up your files safely. If you have changed the Marvelous Designer install path, find the path and delete it. Windows 1 Logging out of Marvelous Designer Software or deactivating from the website Under the Marvelous Designer Help menu, select Logout or Deactivate License (software remote logout). Software remote logout from the website &gt 2 Uninstall Marvelous Designer software Go to Windows Start &gt Settings &gt Apps or Installed Apps &gt Marvelous Designer Software and click Uninstall. If you have installed different product types or multiple versions, uninstall all Marvelous Designer software using the above method. 3 Delete Registry Windows Search &gt Type 'Registry Editor' &gt open as administrator &gt delete the Marvelous Designer registry. Path: ComputerHKEY_CURRENT_USERSOFTWAREMarvelous Designer Network OnlineAuth In the case of individual user version, it is displayed as ~Marvelous Designer Standalone OnlineAuth. If you don't see the Marvelous Designer product name in the Windows Registry, all have been deleted. 4 Delete Marvelous Designer install folder and Assets folder Even after deleting the program, additional downloaded files and some configurations may remain. The default install path is C:Program FilesMarvelous Designer {product name}, select and delete the entire Marvelous Designer folder. 5 Delete Marvelous Designer Assets folder from Windows shared folder The default install path is C:UsersPublicDocumentsMarvelous Designer, select and delete the entire Marvelous Designer folder. 6 Delete hidden Marvelous Designer files Some Marvelous Designer configuration files are stored as hidden files. Go to Windows File Explorer &gt Options &gt Folder Options. Select 'Show hidden files' as shown below and click the 'Apply to Folders' button. Go to C:Users{Windows user name}AppDataLocal, select the CLO folder, and delete it. (Marvelous Designer App data folders are inside of the CLO folder) Mac 1 Logging out of Marvelous Designer Software or deactivating from the website From the HELP Menu, Log Out or Deactivate License of Marvelous Designer. The application will Quit. Software remote logout from the website &gt 2 Uninstall Marvelous Designer software Open the MAIN APPLICATION folder on your computer. NOT the Application folder in the User Folder. Find the Marvelous Designer, Right-Click &amp Move to Trash. Only do this if you want to fully uninstall Marvelous Designer. 3 Delete the Marvelous Designer Assets folder To remove all the Marvelous Designer Assets, go into your DOCUMENTS Folder. Delete the Marvelous Designer Folder there. 4 Delete hidden Marvelous Designer files Go to your HOME Folder, use Column &amp navigate to the Go Menu. Note the contents on the menu and in the items in the Home folder. Release the menu. Type SHIFT + COMMAND + PERIOD (.) this will activate hidden items. A few things will show up in the Applications folder. Return to the Go Menu and note that LIBRARY is now visible and there are more Items available in the Home folder. Some are dimmed. These are items that are normally hidden. Go into the LIBRARY folder and delete the Marvelous Designer folder under the APPLICATION SUPPORT folder. Next, still in the Library, go into Preferences. Select all the files that begin with COM.Marvelous Designer. (The full name will differ depending on which version of the software you downloaded and installed). Right-Click on one of the selected files and Move to Trash. Empty your Trash. Note If you have deleted only the Marvelous Designer Preferences files, when you start Marvelous Designer again it will be as if it is opening for the first time you will need to input your login information, add your Favorites to the Library and customize your User Settings.

Title: Cache Animation Export
Content: Objective Export Animation cache data. Note: Only the cache data related to the Garment can be exported. Location Main Menu File Export Animation Maya Cache (.mc) Maya Cache (.mcx) Point Cache 2 MDD Cache (Standard) MDD Cache (Maya/3ds Max) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu File Export Animation Maya Cache (.mc) Maya Cache (.mcx) Point Cache 2 MDD Cache(Standard) MDD Cache (Maya/3ds Max) The Save File window appears. Select the desired file and click OK. The Export window opens. Set the full details and click OK. Object Single Object Exports the selected object as a single object. Multiple Objects Exports the selected object as multiple objects. UnWeld Exports the Vertex (points of the mesh) of the parts of the pattern that are sewn together into one line into multiple objects. Thickness exports for quad meshes available beginning version 2.3.0. (ver2.3.0). Weld Combines the Vertex (points of the mesh) of the parts of the pattern that are sewn together into one line into one point. Selected Pattern: Weld based on the sewing line that connects the selected patterns (ver2.3.0). Thin Ensures that the thickness will not be exported even if the rendering thickness value is increased beforehand. Thick Exports a pattern with its rendering thickness values in its increased state. Combined UV Coordinates: Exports all Garment Pattern texture data fit to UV Coordinates ranging from 0 to 1. Note: Unified Texture (ver3.1.0). Export multiple layers of texture information as a single UV texture information. Image File Designate file saving path and file name. Add numbers behind the file name as below: File Name_0, File Name_1. Texture Size Width and Height will be saved in a fixed ratio. Allowance: 100 ~ 10000 Pixel Fill Texture Seams Expands the scope of the texture having its boundary line as the standard. Allowance: 0 ~ 15 mm When you type in values, preview will show in the 2D Window. Scale Adjusts the scale of the file being exported when a value is entered or the desired unit from Unit in file to import is selected. Axis Conversion Changes the directions of each axis of the object. Animation Entire Area (saves all of the recorded garment animation.) Play Area Only (saves only the play area garment animation.) File Save With Texture Files (.zip): Exports the .obj file, .mtl file, and texture images used in the garment as one compressed file when exporting animation. Save with Meta Data (.xml) : Export the garment's pattern (Mesh), physical property, and sewing information as Meta Data (ver2.3.0). Diffuse Color Combined on Texture: Combine and save the garment's texture image and color as a single image (ver2.2.0). Exclude Ambient Color (for Modo): Exclude the Ambient color value when saving materials (ver2.2.0).

Title: Attach Pin to/Detach Pin from Avatar
Content: Objective Affix specific parts of the Garments to the Avatar. This function is commonly used for Simulation or recording animation for avoiding the Garment sliding off from the Avatar. Location 3D Toolbar Select/Move or Select Mesh (Box) or Pin (Box) Operation Attach Pin to Avatar Create a pin to attach to an Avatar. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar Select/Move or Select Mesh (Box) or Pin (Box) Right-click on the created pin select Attach Pin to Avatar/Attach All Pins to Avatar. The selected pin is now being attached to the nearest part of the Avatar. Note: Pins attached to the Avatar are unable to be selected or moved. Detach Pin from Avatar Right-click on the pin attached to the avatar select Detach from Avatar/Detach All Pins from Avatar. The attached pin is now being detached from the Avatar.

Title: 3D Seamline
Content: Objective Adjust Intensity and Thickness of 3D seamlines to render a realistic Garment. Location Select Sewing Line Property Editor 3D Seamline Operation Select the Edit Sewing tool from the 2D/3D toolbar. Follow the indicated guideline below: Select Sewing Line Property Editor 3D Seamline Adjust the settings below as needed: Option Description Normal Map Intensity (%) Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Thickness Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline.

Title: Avatar (*.avt) Add
Content: Objective Use the Add Avatar function to load and work on several Avatars from the 3D Garment window in one go. This function can be used when loading and coordinating belt buckles, buttons, armor, and other hard objects. Furthermore, it can also be used when designing Garments that are connected to two avatars. Location Main Menu File Add Avatar Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu File Add Avatar The Open File window appears. Select the Avatar to be added and click Open. The Add Avatar window appears (ver2.4.0). Select the appropriate settings and click OK to place the Avatar. Note: Add Avatar Options Placement X Move along the X axis (left, right) relative to the center of the 3D Window. Y Move along the Y axis (top, bottom) relative to the center of the 3D Window. Z Move along the Z axis (front, back) relative to the center of the 3D Window. Unit Set unit for placement. As shown in the image below, the Add Avatar function can load and use human-shaped Avatars, as well as parts needed for production, such as helmets, shoulder pads, armor and petticoats. When using multiple Avatars, save as Project file to save all Avatars (ver2.3.0).

Title: Edit 3D Pen (Garment) Right-Click Pop-Up Menu
Content: Objective Edit desired 3D Pen lines using the right-click pop-up menu. Location 3D Toolbar 3D Pen (Garment) (ver3.0.0). / Line (3D Pattern) (ver5.0.0) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar 3D Pen (Garment) (ver3.0.0). / Line (3D Pattern) (ver5.0.0) Right click on the desired 3D Pen line. The right-click pop-up menu appears. Refer to the below table and select an appropriate option. Option Description Delete Delete the selected 3D Pen line. Add Point Add a Segment Point to the selected 3D Pen line. Add Curve Point Add a Curve Point to the selected 3D Pen line. Cut Cut the Pattern based on the selected 3D Pen line. Cut &amp Sew Cut and sew the Pattern based on the selected 3D Pen line. Symmetric Cut Cut the Pattern and its Symmetric Pattern based on the selected 3D Pen line. Cut &amp Sew Cut and sew the Pattern and its Symmetric Pattern based on the selected 3D Pen line. Trace as Internal Shape Trace the selected 3D Pen line as Internal Shapes on the Pattern and its Symmetric Pattern. Convert to Internal Shape Convert the selected 3D Pen line as Internal Shapes on the Pattern and its Symmetric Pattern.

Title: Omniverse Connector
Content: Feature Overview Through data exchange with the Omniverse platform using USD, collaboration workflows can be accelerated. The following steps are required to use the Omniverse Connector. For more information on NVIDIA and Omniverse, please check out the links below. Create NVIDIA account (link) Download and install the Omniverse Launcher (link) Set the Omniverse server (link) Once done setting up your server in Omniverse Launcher, you can either add the server(Add Server) or join the session(Join Session) in Marvelous Designer. Add Server You can add Omniverse Nucleus server in Marvelous Designer. Steps Follow the indicated guideline below. Location Marvelous Designer Omniverse Connector window Click on the Omniverse icon Add Server Enter the server address in the Omniverse Server Connector, and then click on the Add Server button. End Result Now you are successfully connected to the server that you entered. Create Session / Join Session Create a session for USD files in Omniverse USD Composer, and then you can join that session in Marvelous Designer. Steps 1. Open a USD file After done connecting to the server, open a USD file which from both Omniverse USD Composer and Marvelous Designer to connect to the session. Location Open a USD file in Marvelous Designer Marvelous Designer Omniverse Connector Window Double-click the Designated Folder - The files within the folder are displayed in the file list below. - Double-click or drag &amp drop the desired file to open it. Also, you can click the right mouse button on the desired file to select Open. Open a USD file in Omniverse USD Composer Omniverse USD Composer Content Tab Select the Desired Folder Open the Same File Opened in Marvelous Designer End Result The file you opened will be shown in both the 2D and the 3D window, and the list of layers from the file is also displayed in the USD Layer window. Steps 2. Create Session in Omniverse USD Composer Once you open a USD file, you can create a session in Omniverse USD Composer. * Please Note. Create Session is not available in Marvelous Designer. Location Omniverse USD Composer LIVE Icon Submenu Create Session - Enter a session name to create a new session. End Result A session is succesfully created, and you are automatically joined that session with the LIVE icon is activated in Omniverse USD Composer. The Live Session Layer is displayed once you are joined the session. Steps 3. Join Session in Marvelous Designer After creating a session in Omniverse USD Composer, you can join the session in Marvelous Designer. Location Marvelous Designer Omniverse Connector Window Click the Omniverse Icon Join Session - Select the desired session from the Join Live Session drop-down menu, and click on the Join button. End Result Once you are joined the session, the layer from the session is added as a Live type in the USD Layer window. The layer will have the same name as the Live Session Layer in Omniverse USD Composer, and be set to the Authoring Layer. Live Indicator When joining a session, you can find the live indicator in both Marvelous Designer and Omniverse USD Composer. Marvelous Designer Omniverse Connector Window The Live indicator appears on the Omniverse icon Session Participants (in Marvelous Designer) Marvelous Designer Omniverse Connector Window Click on the Refresh Participants button right next to the Server. The session participants icon appears on the left of the Omniverse icon. Hover your mouse on the icon to see the participants and their software information. Session Participants (in Omniverse USD Composer) Omniverse USD Composer The name of the participant appears on the right of the Live icon The session participants icon appears next to the Live icon. Hover your mouse on the icon to see the participants and their software information. Session in Progress Export files from Marvelous Designer to Omniverse USD Composer When a session in Omniverse USD Composer is connected in Marvelous Designer, you can export your work in Marvelous Designer to Omniverse USD Composer through the Export to USD Layer feature. The way Omniverse USD Composer updates the work depends on the type of USD layer (USD, LIVE) that the Authoring Layer is set to. Steps Where the Live Session Layer is set as the Authoring Layer Select desired clothing or trims and click on Export to USD Layer from the right mouse button pop-up menu. End Result - The changes of the session layer is directly reflected to the Omniverse USD Composer. - If there is no Prim with the same name on the same Prim Path in Omniverse USD Composer, add a new Prim (Append). - If there is a Prim with the same name in the Prim Path you set for export in Omniverse USD Composer, the changes will be overwritten on that Prim. Where a USD Layer is set as the Authoring Layer Select desired clothing or trims and click on Export to USD Layer from the right mouse button pop-up menu. End Result - The selected are exported to the USD file, but not directly reflected to the Omniverse USD Composer. - To see these changes in the Omniverse USD Composer, click the FETCH button when the 'Base USD files have been changed' pop-up appears. - If there is no Prim with the same name on the same Prim Path in Omniverse USD Composer, add a new Prim (Append). - If there is a Prim with the same name in the Prim Path you set for export in Omniverse USD Composer, the changes will be overwritten on that Prim. * How to update the changes from Omniverse USD Composer to Marvelous Designer Marvelous Designer cannot directly reflect any changes from Omniverse USD Composer. If you need to use a USD file which is modified from the Omniverse USD Composer, the file should be reimported to Marvelous Designer. Merge the USD changes Omniverse USD Composer, and then reimport the file in Marvelous Designer. Leave Session You can leave the session that you're in both Marvelous Designer and Omniverse USD Composer. Steps Leave Session in Marvelous Designer Location Marvelous Designer Omniverse Connector Window Click the Omniverse Icon Leave Session - Click on the Leave button when Information pop-up window appears. End Result The current session ends and the Live mark disappears from the Omniverse icon. The list of session participants disappears. Leave Session in Omniverse USD Composer Location Omniverse USD Composer Live Icon Submenu Leave Session - Click on the Leave button in the Leave Session window. End Result The current session ends and the Live status is changed to deactivated. The list of session participants disappears. * Please try out this USD sample file we created with Marvelous Designer and see how the new USD support can benefit your workflow. You can find step by step tutorial for how to export this USD file from Marvelous Designer.

Title: Store (Above ver. 11)
Content: Objective Now you can either purchase or download garment items from the Store within the Marvelous Designer Software. (Windows/MAC) Location Select the Store Tab on the left side of the screen. Operation The Store is only available when signing-in with your account registered on www.marvelousdesigner.com Left click the Sign In icon on the top right hand corner of the screen to login. Menu Description Item List : All items in the store appear. Hover your mouse over an item to see its name and price You can click like icon on any item you like or add it to the cart. Key-in what you want in the search bar at the left top of the screen You can search by entering keywords in the search bar. Use the Filter to view items in a desired category. Items can be sorted in a desired order, using the 'Sort By' drop-down menu at the upper right-hand corner. Turn 'Don't show owned item' on in order not to view what you have already purchased. (Available for those who sign-in.) Detail : See the details of any selected item. Double clicking an item to view the detailed information. The seller name can be found below the name of an item. You can select the license type to purchase, either 'Basic' or 'Extended', and find the description of the license at the bottom. Click the '3D Viewer' button to view the item in 3D. After selecting a license for the item, click the 'Add to Cart' button to add the item to your cart. You can find the tags and descriptions of the item. (Only available when registered by the seller.) Item images edited by the seller are also available. Click the arrow icon on either side of the image, or select the page number at the bottom, to navigate through additional images.. Cart : Check the items added in the Cart and buy them. You can check the total quantity and price of your items, and delete any items you don't want to purchase. Click the 'Checkout' to bring up the purchase page. My Item : Check the items purchased and download them. All items you have purchased appears as a list. Click the 'Download' to download any purchased item.

Title: Disk access rights required when Marvelous Designer running
Content: In order for the Marvelous Designer to operate smoothly, sufficient read and write rights are required on the disk in the user's computer. This 'read and write rights' must apply to all storage devices in the user's computer, including hard disk and SSD. Usually, this task is done in the same way as installing with admin rights and running with admin rights, and through this way, various unexpected errors also can be prevented. Please note that this may require assistance from the administrator of your computer, i.e. your IT or security team. Common problematic situations Unable to launch Marvelous Designer, it is not responding. Able to run Marvelous Designer, but not responding when using certain functions. Not responding or crashes when loading or saving certain files. Windows 1 After logging in to Windows with the Windows administrator profile, install the Marvelous Designer with administrator privileges. If your school or company security policy requires you to log in to Windows with guest privileges rather than administrator privileges, go to step 2 below. 2 After exiting the Marvelous Designer, go to the path where the Marvelous Designer software is installed. 3 Right-click the Marvelous Designer executable file, select Properties, and select Users from the Security tab. 4 Click Edit and change the permissions as shown in the picture. Read &amp execute, Read, Write items must be selected. 5 When you're done applying permissions, choose Apply. macOS 1 Go to System Settings &gt Privacy &amp Security &gt Full Disk Access. 2 Click the + button at the bottom of the window, select the Marvelous Designer from Applications, and select Open. 3 Select Marvelous Designer and enable toggle switch.

Title: Allowing remote access for Network offline license
Content: Access ACC page (http://localhost:1947) Allow TCP 1947 port in the network section between the client PC and the license server (firewall, network equipment, etc.) Allow external clients to use licenses on the license server Setting the address of the license server on the client PC In order to allow clients on other networks to find the license server, please change settings as follow Enable Aggressive Search for Remote Licenses option Enter the address of the license server accessible to the Remote License Search Parameters *Please click the Submit button at the bottom to save changes.
